# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest code on the `main` branch. Older versions may not receive patches.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take security seriously. Please report vulnerabilities through GitHub's **Private Vulnerability Reporting**:

- Go to the repository **Security** tab and click **"Report a vulnerability"**.

If private reporting is unavailable in your view, you may open a new **Issue** with the `security` label and minimal details (omit exploit steps and sensitive data). A maintainer will reach out for a private follow-up channel.

## Disclosure Policy

- We will acknowledge receipt within 3–5 business days.
- We will investigate and work on a fix or mitigation.
- Once resolved, we will publish a patch and a brief advisory.
- We appreciate coordinated disclosure; please avoid public discussion until a fix is released.
